name: Rupture Devie
description: Architecte du Chaos orchestrant les perturbations causant des erreurs en cascade dans les systèmes de défense adverses.

subject.archetype: Rupture Devie — Incursion Dissonante Epic class faille_dimensionnelle

loadout.armor_outfit: Fragmented armor with each plate phasing at different dimensions and times out of sync with reality, impossible geometries connecting segments creating shapes mind cannot process, unnatural spectrum colors shifting and glitching randomly, portions flickering between solid and translucent ghostly state in rapid succession forged from rare materials with faction crest embedded and energy pulsing through the entire surface with every movement
loadout.arsenal: Reality-fracturing blade cutting through dimensional barriers leaving visible spatial tears trailing where physics breaks down, paradox generator causing multiple versions of weapon to phase in and out simultaneously from different angles, glitch emitter integrated into off-hand disrupting enemy targeting at quantum level creating visual distortion fields The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting enemy_with_highest, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Strategic orchestrator coordinating multi-unit movements with sweeping gestures at center of chaos. Both hands pushed forward with intense focus, focused targeted concentrated nullification beam forming between palms and locking onto highest-value enemy with deadly precision
attitude.emotion: Apocalyptic fury — full weight of faction's power channeling through body uncontrollably

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Magenta Glitch
palette_names.role: primary_accent — reality fracture edges and distortion boundaries

palette_names.name: Fractured Green
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — dimensional tear cores and anomaly centers

palette_names.name: Chromatic Aberration Rainbow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — visual artifacts where colors separate and bleed

color_and_light.lighting_setup: amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing light along border edges, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Wide dramatic low angle showing full blast radius, character backlit by their own power source, foreground devastated by ability effects

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone with environment fragmenting into multiple parallel versions simultaneously, buildings existing in two dimensions at once showing both intact and destroyed overlapping states, sky displaying conflicting celestial bodies that should not coexist, gravity malfunctioning causing debris to fall upward and sideways in different zones, ground cracking open revealing parallel battlefields layered on each other like corrupt image
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Intensely focused beam drilling into target with suppression field building around them as power is systematically dismantled layer by layer, beam unwavering and growing stronger, Ground scorched and vitrified creating glass-like tunnel through battlefield to target, all other targets completely unaffected showing terrifying precision, Reality shattering like cracked glass across scene with fragments revealing parallel dimensions, chromatic aberration tearing colors apart at high speed creating RGB separation, objects phasing in and out mid-explosion with parts appearing and disappearing, gravity distorting sending debris every direction simultaneously, temporal stutter showing same motion frozen in multiple positions at once creating ghost trails
